title: Design artifact grounded in the current code
summary: Verify what the current interface and its data actually do, agree on a mockup, and record decisions before writing a new implementation in the user stack.
when_to_use: The user wants to change a screen that already exists in the repository.
avoid_when: There is no interface to change, or the fix is already specified and needs no design pass.

anatomy.purpose: Records the real components, queries and what each displayed value counts.
Shows the interface as it is, before the proposed change.
Stores what changed between versions and why.
Tells the coding step which decisions are settled.

tokens.name: artifact.direction
tokens.purpose: The visual direction taken from the product tokens, not from a generic template.

states.name: as-is
states.behavior: Matches the current screen before any new idea is drawn.

states.name: proposed
states.behavior: Changes only the agreed parts and keeps verified facts stable.

responsive: Review the mockup at the widths the existing screen already supports.
accessibility: Carry over the existing names of controls unless the change explicitly alters them.
Check contrast again if the proposal changes color or type.
implementation_steps: Read the current component and the data it displays. Write down facts, not guesses.
Reproduce the current screen, then the proposed change, using the product tokens.
Record the decision in the project design notes.
Implement only the settled change in the user stack. Do not ship the exploration mockup as production code.
